rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass in all four views, so it has acceptable gesture clarity and repair integrity. However, it behaves like a sealed object with very little void/public threshold, and the verified access edge is not given a legible public carve, seam, or undercut. That is a problem for the neighborhood_living brief, which requires an active ground edge and at least one clear public void/terrace. The silhouette is not literally stairlike in a bad way, but it is still essentially a compact prismatic extrusion with only mild shaping, so it lacks enough section or ground consequence to support the stated program. It does not visibly collide across views, and it is coherent in more than one view, so it is structurally sound; the main failure is program-response, not manifold integrity.
